title: His Majesty's Theatre, London
axis: +X points toward Charles II Street along Haymarket. +Z faces Haymarket.

nativeAxes.x: toward Charles II Street along the front

source: Named OpenStreetMap theatre and distinct Royal Opera Arcade, independently identified by Historic England.
identityStatus: The six-point outer perimeter of OpenStreetMap way 143641503 is named and matches Wikidata Q1155331 and statutory Historic England reference 1357090. The adjacent Royal Opera Arcade is individually protected and separately mapped.

terrainContact.basis: Original street elevation outside the central Haymarket entrance canopy.

notes: Historic England records the four-storey, nine-bay Haymarket elevation, a five-bay giant Corinthian loggia, three-bay side return, mansards, square French dome, octagonal lantern and glass-and-iron canopy. A byte-exact public-domain Qualla photograph shows the standing street-facing proportions.
